ledger_kind: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - generated by backtest.fixtures.generate (seed 1220). No row is a real wager and no number here is evidence about the real world.

reward_tiers.name: Fundable
reward_tiers.reward: bankroll allocation, up to 2.0% of roll per bet, monthly operating budget, and first claim on paid data sources

reward_tiers.name: Contender
reward_tiers.reward: paper-money allocation at 0.5% of roll, shared GPU/backtest queue priority, and a named slot in the weekly review

reward_tiers.name: Watchlist
reward_tiers.reward: tracked on the board, no allocation; gets a data-request slot

reward_tiers.name: Bench
reward_tiers.reward: no allocation; must re-derive the thesis before re-entering

gates.name: Data integrity
gates.threshold: 0 FAIL from pipelines.validate; every published row has an official source link; 0 blank cells without a flag
gates.blocks: everything - a broken table breaks every decision

gates.name: Sample size
gates.threshold: n >= 300 settled bets, >= 2 distinct seasons, >= 30 bets in each
gates.observed: n=180, seasons=3, min bets in a season=60
gates.blocks: any claim that a strategy is skill rather than luck

gates.name: Post-vig edge
gates.threshold: mean edge >= 2.0% AND >= 55% of bets with edge > 0
gates.data_required: origination output + a market price to subtract
gates.blocks: bet sizing and the leaderboard score

gates.name: Closing-line value
gates.threshold: mean CLV >= +0.5 pts on spread/total, >= 1.5% on ML/props
gates.data_required: opening and closing market prices per bet
gates.blocks: whether any edge is real or an artefact

gates.name: Luck-adjusted return
gates.threshold: 95% block-bootstrap CI (blocks = weeks) of mean PnL/100 excludes 0
gates.blocks: reward eligibility, tier 1 and 2

gates.name: Drawdown control
gates.threshold: max drawdown <= 25% of starting bankroll at the declared fractional-Kelly stake
gates.blocks: bankroll policy

gates.name: Correlation cap
gates.threshold: max |rho| over all leg pairs <= 0.35; every rho measured, none assumed; parlays with an unknown rho are not priced
gates.blocks: every multi-leg product

gates.name: Regime robustness
gates.threshold: no single season carries > 40% of total edge; every season's PnL/100 > -2.0
gates.observed: largest season share 0.4751, worst season PnL/100 -0.043
gates.blocks: whether the edge survives a rule change

gates.name: Parameter stability
gates.threshold: under +/-20% perturbation of each prior: published line moves <= 0.5 pts and the signalled bet set overlaps >= 80%
gates.observed: max line shift 3.0 pts, signal overlap 0.9231
gates.blocks: whether the model is a machine or a coin

gates.name: Capacity / liquidity
gates.threshold: stake <= 1% of the posted limit; expected handle <= 0.5% of the market pool
gates.blocks: whether the strategy scales past paper

gates.name: Timing and leakage
gates.threshold: every input row fetched strictly before that game's kickoff; 0 rows where the official page already printed a final score
gates.observed: 0 input rows captured at or after kickoff
gates.blocks: every accuracy claim
